---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a project capability or workflow improvement.
title: "[Feature]: "
---

## Problem

What user or operational problem would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the capability and its expected behavior.

## Safety and contracts

- Could this affect order submission, position sizing, or risk controls?
- Would it change an API or persisted data contract?
- How should it behave when dependencies or broker responses are unavailable?

## Alternatives

Describe other approaches considered.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The expected behavior is testable.
- [ ] Failure and rollback behavior are defined.
- [ ] Live-trading impact and required approvals are documented.
